content:
**#479/#509: dos seams que parecían cerrados**

Two seams that looked closed and were not.

#479 — brain declares ONE neutral credential and nothing used it. getVcs() bound a credential only when a caller passed `identity`, and measured, exactly 1 of 20+ call sites does. The same audit authenticated two ways depending on provider with nothing asserting they agreed. Fix belongs in getVcs(), not threaded through the audit path.

The residual, visible only after removing the accident hiding it: ci-context.mjs imported prView STRAIGHT from providers/github.mjs, bypassing getVcs() and its credential resolution. It looked fine because every job needing the PR body also set GH_TOKEN, so gh authenticated by accident. Declaring VCS_TOKEN alone turned issue-link red.

#509 — promoting doctrine re-derives a written cascade every time. brain:promote handles the ADR shape only, so #529's methodology-doc ruling shipped as a bespoke script that missed regenerating AGENTS.md; CI caught it on the human's signing commit. brain:promote ALREADY does that. Two implementations of a written rule, one commit after it was written.

Trap: compileAgentsMd(docs) keys by relPath and falls back to `?? ''` per section — passing an ARRAY silently emits empty sections. It deleted 543 lines and returned successfully.
